brief: 7 CLI tools real engineers run every single day.

slots.toolTagline: fuzzy finder that filters files and history in real time.
slots.bodyText: Stop typing paths. fzf gives you interactive search across shells, git history, and processes with blazing speed.
slots.skill1Body: Interactive fuzzy filtering of lists, files, and command history.
slots.skill2Body: Jumping to files and recalling long shell commands instantly.
slots.skill3Body: Available on brew, apt, and most package managers.
slots.skill4Body: Bind it to Ctrl+R to replace default history search.

slots.toolTagline: grep rewritten in Rust for recursive code search at ludicrous speed.
slots.bodyText: Ripgrep respects gitignore and skips hidden files by default. rg is the fastest way to search millions of lines.
slots.skill1Body: Recursively searches code while respecting project ignore rules.
slots.skill2Body: Finding strings across large repos without waiting.
slots.skill3Body: Single binary download or cargo install ripgrep.
slots.skill4Body: Use -C 2 to show two lines of context around matches.
slots.footerNote: grep is dead, long live rg

slots.toolTagline: A cat clone with syntax highlighting, git integration, and automatic paging.
slots.bodyText: Replace cat with bat and never read plain code again. It prints line numbers and diffs side by side.
slots.skill1Body: Syntax highlights any file with line numbers and git changes.
slots.skill2Body: Quickly reading config files and source code in terminal.
slots.skill3Body: brew install bat or cargo build from source.
slots.skill4Body: Alias cat to bat and use --plain for pipe compatibility.

slots.toolTagline: A modern replacement for ls with git awareness and colorful output.
slots.bodyText: eza shows icons, file sizes, and git status in a single glance. It turns boring directory listings into readable dashboards.
slots.skill1Body: Lists files with icons, tree view, and git metadata.
slots.skill2Body: Navigating project trees and spotting modified files fast.
slots.skill3Body: cargo install eza or grab the latest release binary.
slots.skill4Body: Use -l --git --icons for the ultimate directory overview.

slots.toolTagline: A smarter cd command that learns your habits and jumps anywhere.
slots.bodyText: Forget typing full paths. zoxide ranks directories by frequency so z foo lands exactly where you mean.
slots.skill1Body: Remembers visited directories and jumps to the best match.
slots.skill2Body: Hopping between deep project folders without typing paths.
slots.skill3Body: curl install script or package manager one-liner.
slots.skill4Body: Init with your shell and alias cd to z.

slots.toolTagline: A minimal, blazing-fast prompt written in Rust for any shell.
slots.bodyText: Starship shows git branch, lang versions, and exit codes instantly. It starts in milliseconds and works everywhere.
slots.skill1Body: Renders a rich shell prompt with context-aware info.
slots.skill2Body: Keeping track of git status and toolchain versions visually.
slots.skill3Body: One shell script or brew install starship.
slots.skill4Body: Add battery and kubernetes modules for full devops visibility.

slots.ctaBody: Install the modern CLI stack and spend less time typing paths. Your terminal deserves an upgrade.
